attack_description: corr-rate-marine-envelope-v1 (2026-08-15) co-discovered that the deployed env_features() 'marine' flag conflates seawater immersion with atmospheric exposure (has('seawater','sea water','marine','atmospheric')): 313/499 (62.7%) of deployed marine_feature==1 rows are actually atmospheric. That flag is one of the 13 env features consumed by build_matrix() and fed directly into the SAME GroupKFold(family) HistGBM pipeline that produced the promoted KPI's R2=0.132087 -- so the defect was never isolated to the marine-only test split; it is baked into the promoted KPI's own training features. This re-runs the identical family-safe pipeline with ONLY the marine flag corrected (restricted to true seawater/sea-water substrings) and compares to the deployed (buggy) feature result on the identical rows/model/seed/CV.
attacks_claim: evidence/phase0/kpis/corr-rate-family-safe-qspr-kpi.v1.dsse.json (GroupKFold(group=metallurgical_family, 5-fold) HistGBM R2=0.132087, promoted 2026-08-04, campaign item V1-KPI-BARR, 'the module's strongest rights-clean empirical claim').

refutation_criterion: REFUTED if corrected_feature.family_safe.gbm.r2 <= 0.0 OR corrected_feature.family_safe_error_reduction_vs_best_baseline_pct <= 0.0 (identical classified-subset rows/model/seed/CV as the promoted corr-rate-family-safe-qspr-kpi.v1); SURVIVED otherwise, even if r2 changes materially relative to the buggy-feature promoted number.
